text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин has invited me to a tea
party at
the Mejiro family home today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are, Trainer! ...Wait a
moment.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I said you could wear your normal
clothes. Don't
you have trouble
breathing in that restrictive
suit?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list:
I mean, this is a tea party with the renowned
Mejiro family, so...

text_block_list.text:
I see... What you're saying is that you're
nervous.
In other words, this is an
opportunity for me to
exhibit my skills.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Trainer. Simply follow my
lead.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Thus, the tea party begins, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, the next step is to use your knife
to spread
some jam and clotted cream
onto your scone.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... The jam and cream are
glistening! They
look delicious...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: ...Gah! N-now, take a bite.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Quickly, now, before my stomach takes
charge.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I still have an important duty to fulfill!
So, I must
refrain...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Excuse me, miss. Is now an okay time?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Household Staff

text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it's been a while, hasn't it? Yes,
by all
means, allow me to introduce you
to my trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, state your name as you shake
hands. There is
nothing more important
to good manners than a proper
greeting.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
With Мэдзиро МакКуин's support, I follow
the
proper manners in exchanging
introductions with
the staff member.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... You managed to do it correctly.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
There's no need to thank me. It was no
trouble.
You and I are a team, after all.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
...You're unusually silent, Trainer. Is
something
the matter?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: I was just thinking about how cool you are.

I was just thinking that I'd better up my game to
be fit to stand by your side.

text_block_list.text: Wha?! C-c...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Uh, I mean, of course. I am a proud
Mejiro, after
all.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But... "cool," you say? You really think
so?
Hehehe...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I suppose I must do my best and show you just how cool I really am.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Umm... I suppose there was nothing to
worry
about, but... I probably should
announce my
presence, eh?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
R-Ryan?! How long have you been
standing
there?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Well... I caught that whole "show you
how cool I
really am" bit, if that's what
you mean.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You really laid it on thick there.
Sheesh...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Y-you have it all wrong! Please don't
take that
remark as me being arrogant! I
j-just got a little
carried away!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: My!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I say you're good enough just the
way you
are. Although, I would expect
such a notion from
my trainer all the
same.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I, as well, ought to respond in kind to
that spirit
of yours.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Allow me to instruct you on a variety of
topics,
from the proper way to drink tea
to making polite
introductions.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Today, I shall be the trainer!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you're in a good mood, McQueen.
Guess I
didn't need to worry after all.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ryan! Yes, I am giving my trainer my full
support.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Uhuh, good job, good job. ♪ I'd like to
have a
little chat with your trainer too, in
that case.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, by all means.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The intensive training shall begin at
once!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин maintains as much
"coolness" as
she can muster as she
supports me through our
tea party.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After that, Мэдзиро МакКуин continues to
teach
me etiquette as we enjoy our tea
party.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
